text:
Absolutely — here’s a simple Mediterranean-leaning grocery plan for the week for you and your partner, kept flexible and low-tracking:

- Produce: lemons, garlic, onions, tomatoes, cucumbers, bell peppers, spinach or greens, zucchini, carrots, berries, apples, fresh herbs
- Proteins: chicken, salmon or other fish, eggs, Greek yogurt, chickpeas, lentils, feta
- Carbs/starches: rice or couscous, potatoes, whole-grain bread or pita, pasta
- Pantry: olive oil, olives, canned tomatoes, broth, tahini, hummus, beans, nuts
- Extras: avocado, pickles, anything you like for easy mezze-style meals

If you want, I can turn this into a full day-by-day dinner plan or trim it to a budget.
